visualStyle: Original pixel-style vector art with crisp edges and a restrained sci-fi survival palette.

scenes.alt: A damaged survey ship lies in a dark, rust-colored basin beneath distant electrical clouds.
A narrow route crosses a sharp glass ridge toward a distant weather station.
A sheltered dry ravine cuts through blocky ochre cliffs with a small cyan filter cache.
An abandoned weather station glows with one cyan signal light on the empty plain.
A low maintenance trench offers shelter from a wall of blue-white electrical storm clouds.
The repaired survey ship rises from the planet as a blue engine plume cuts through the storm.
The survey ship drifts in low orbit above Vesper-6, sparks trailing from a breach in its hull.
A small grey moon ringed with debris, a cyan beacon blinking on its dark side.
A squat relay tower with solar vanes on black rock, one cyan window lit.
A pilot faces a large console whose screen shows a face with one amber eye and one cyan eye.
A cockpit view of space and dust, the navigation display showing three courses.
The survey ship at the edge of a grey haze of rock and ice.
A small outpost with a dish antenna on an asteroid, under a dim sun.
A rust-colored mining tug with a broken cargo arm drifts in grey dust beside the survey ship.
Green navigation beacons lead toward a ring station and a blue-green planet.
